shots.line: Have you ever imagined, what if you could swap faces with anyone?
shots.notes: Biometric Mirror — Smart mirror reflection, 3D face-mesh wireframe scan, biometric HUD
The Dad Face — Magnetic snap, bushy mustache, reading glasses, steaming coffee mug
The Crush Face — Anime bloom, sparkle eyes, blushing cheeks, floating hearts, shy wave
The President — Camera flash, silver hair swoop, red power tie, secret service earpiece

shots.line: Or imagine waking up with your favorite movie star's face?
shots.notes: Hollywood Chad — Golden spotlight, chiseled jaw, sunglasses drop, tooth glint ding, flexing laugh
The Glitch Punchline — Face glitch tear, mask peels off, bewildered stickman, end card
